Name: Farmers can run any kind of shop they want. I created a light pink UI (English version).
Author: Cherr030
Description:
[center][color=#d5a6bd][size=1]Hello! I made the English version of the UI using a translator. The space was limited, and I’m really not good at English, but I typed everything one by one.[/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#d5a6bd][size=1]Honestly, I know I made some of the [/size][/color][b][color=#d5a6bd][size=1]U’s and V’s[/size][/color][/b][color=#d5a6bd][size=1] confusing, so please bear with it and take it as it is! :D[/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#d5a6bd][size=1]The letters honestly look like little worms, but please be understanding! I was originally only planning to make the Korean version.[/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#d5a6bd][size=1]Thankfully, someone from China offered to make the Chinese version themselves, so that worked out really well. No one offered to make the English version, so I had to do it myself.[/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#d5a6bd][size=1]So please be patient and understanding even if some of the translations are a complete mess! :D[/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#d5a6bd][size=1]Please paste it directly into the UI![/size][/color]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50662/50662-1786621841-1514742354.jpg[/img][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#d5a6bd][size=1]Based on Subyakk’s interface design.


I registered it using an English translator, so I’m not really sure what it actually says. English was the only subject I was bad at on exams. 😭 [/size][/color][/center]
